purpose: P1-05 CI schema bootstrap provenance and staleness contract
policy: Official CI consumers must call the canonical bootstrap command instead of replaying arbitrary migrations.
Every migration referenced by the bootstrap must exist in worker-airtrust/migrations.
A Schema V2 change newer than reviewed_through_schema_v2_change that targets a critical table fails closed until this contract/bootstrap is reviewed.
No remote D1 target is permitted by this guard or bootstrap.
Reviewed critical Schema V2 changes newer than the base marker must be hash-pinned by filename; a later lower-numbered migration is not implicitly reviewed.
